package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for error_code_literals_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated string error codes without a centralized catalog.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func handlerLogin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	email := r.FormValue("email")
	if email == "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"code": "ERR_001", "msg": "email required"})
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"token":"abc123"}`))
}

func handlerSignup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	email := r.FormValue("email")
	if email == "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"code": "ERR_001", "msg": "email required"})
		return
	}
	pass := r.FormValue("password")
	if len(pass) < 8 {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"code": "ERR_002", "msg": "password too short"})
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"created"}`))
}
